sentences.text: Xuwulong is a genus of hadrosauroid dinosaur discovered in the Early Cretaceous Yujingzi Basin within Gansu Province, northwestern China.
This animal belongs to the class Ornithischia and sits within the parent group Hadrosauroidea.
The species is known from a single articulated holotype specimen, which is the specific sample the species is based on, containing a complete skull, nearly complete spine, and full left pelvis.
Named by You Hailu, Li Daqing, and Liu Weichang in 2011, the type species Xuwulong yueluni honors Professor Wang Yue-lun.
Xuwulong lived between 121.4 and 113.2 million years ago during the Aptian stage.
Fossil evidence places this dinosaur in the upper Aptian stage of the Xiagou Formation.
